rout.name: Open Field
rout.lore: The border farmers left their fields before the soldiers arrived.

rout.name: River Crossing
rout.lore: Old toll stones mark the crossing; the bridge now belongs to whoever holds it.

rout.name: Forest Ambush
rout.lore: The forest has swallowed the old road, but scouts still know its turns.

rout.name: Chokepoint
rout.lore: Two ridges narrow the road to a place a few soldiers can hold.

rout.name: Frozen Pass
rout.lore: Caravans once crossed this pass before the first winter snows.

rout.name: Caldera
rout.lore: The road follows the rim of a furnace older than the empire.

rout.name: Corridor Siege
rout.lore: The garrison built these passages for defense, not retreat.

rout.name: Castle Ruins
rout.lore: Grass grows through the floor where the old court once assembled.

rout.name: Mire Crossing
rout.lore: The causeway is gone; only its stone markers rise above the marsh.

rout.name: Glacier Run
rout.lore: Meltwater runs beneath the ice and hollows out the trail.

rout.name: Magma Flow
rout.lore: Red seams cut through the road the last surveyors marked.

rout.name: Snowbound Woods
rout.lore: Snow muffles the woods; the first sign of the hunters is their breath.

rout.name: Ashen Ridge
rout.lore: The ridge cooled into teeth of black glass; the garrison holds the high stones.

rout.name: Corner Camp
rout.lore: The patrol made camp where two roads met, and found both roads already watched.

rout.name: Caught in the Open
rout.lore: Open ground, a column on the march, and riders waiting in the long grass to either side.

rout.name: Two Camps
rout.lore: Two warbands, one ridge between them, and no love lost: the one that charges hopes the other is watching.

rout.name: The Warband
rout.lore: A warband holds together by two hands on its collar. Cut both, and the rest go home.

rout.name: Three Roads
rout.lore: The old road runs straight and open; the drovers kept to the woods on either side.

seize.name: Castle Assault
seize.lore: The outer walls still bear the old kingdom's weathered crest.

seize.name: Great Hall
seize.lore: The court's banners hang above a hall emptied for battle.

seize.name: Hilltop Fortress
seize.lore: The fort watches the roads that once carried grain to the capital.

seize.name: Glacier Fortress
seize.lore: Ice seals the old gates; the garrison keeps one approach open.

seize.name: Eruption Point
seize.lore: A watchtower stands where the mountain last broke open.

seize.name: Boss Intent Bastion
seize.lore: The bastion's firing lanes leave little shelter for an advancing army.

seize.name: Dark Champion Keep
seize.lore: The keep commands the last road into the imperial heartland.

seize.name: Eldritch Sanctum
seize.lore: The ritual has worn channels into stone that once held a throne.

seize.name: Three Roads Keep
seize.lore: Whoever holds the keep at the end of the old road holds all three ways in.

seize.name: The Long Road
seize.lore: One road through the pass, a keep at the far end, and something moving in the trees above it.

seize.name: Two Gates
seize.lore: Two companies, two gates, one throne between them. Whoever reaches it first holds the hall.

escape.name: Pursuit Road
escape.lore: An abandoned supply road offers the only clear route out.

escape.name: River Flight
escape.lore: The river bends toward open country beyond the last patrol.

escape.name: Hunter's Woods
escape.lore: Hunters' trails cross these woods, too narrow for a formed company.

escape.name: Frozen Flight
escape.lore: The fleeing column has left dark tracks across the snow.
